title: 2017/05/17: Senate hearing on Bill C16
summary: Jordan Peterson's testimony at the Canadian Senate hearing on Bill C16, which added gender identity and expression to protected grounds. He argues against compelled speech.
why: Referenced as the hearing that propelled Peterson to public visibility and as a source on the compelled speech debate.

quote.text: This was precisely the argument in the Canadian Senate, 2 years ago, that propelled Jordan Peterson to public visibility.
